architecture_summary: Modular React SPA. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. React Router v6 for navigation. Tailwind CSS for styling. No state management library (use React context for global state if needed).

tickets.title: Build Dashboard Home page (screen_1_dashboard_home)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React component. Extract reusable widgets (announcements, upcoming deadlines, quick actions) into separate components. Use Tailwind for styling. Preserve all visual fidelity and interactions (hover, click).
acceptance_criteria: All interactive elements functional (hover states, click handlers)

tickets.title: Build Homework Search page (screen_2_homework_search)
tickets.description: Create search interface with filters (subject, due date, status). Implement search results list with pagination. Extract search bar and filter panel into reusable components. Add client-side search/filter logic (debounced input).

tickets.title: Build Calendar/Exams Schedule page (screen_3_calendar_exams_schedule)
tickets.description: Implement calendar view with exam schedule overlay. Use react-big-calendar or similar for calendar component. Extract event cards into reusable component. Add month/week/day view toggle. Sync with mock API data.

tickets.title: Build Transaction Detail page (detail_transaksi)
tickets.description: Create transaction detail view with payment breakdown, status timeline, and action buttons. Extract timeline component. Add print/download functionality for receipts. Implement status badge logic.

tickets.title: Create shared layout components
tickets.description: Build reusable layout components: header, sidebar, footer. Implement responsive navigation. Add dark/light mode toggle. Extract into src/components/layout/.

tickets.title: Set up routing and app shell
tickets.description: Configure React Router. Create app shell with persistent layout components. Implement route guards for auth. Add 404 page. Wire up all page components.
acceptance_criteria: No route flashes or layout shifts
